neighbours.label: The river names Dniester / Dnipro spelled with a 'Dn' start, in any language (Dniester, Dnjestr, Днестр, Dnipro; Dnieper weaker), lighting up on the piece right after the 'D'. Quiet for other rivers (Danube, Prut, Vistula) and for the Romanian name Nistru. Side trigger: the third digit of an 1880s year in digits (1885), not 1890s or 1900s.
